bg::Absolutely. Every Aquafarer board pa: Абсолютно. С тегло само 18-22 паунда е лесно да се носи до плажа, езерото или през летищните терминали.
bg::Our All-Around SUPs support up to 22: Нашите SUPs универсални лодки поддържат до 220 lbs. Серията Touring и Yoga поддържат до 250 lbs. bg::Yes. We offer curated bundles that s: Да. Предлагаме подбрани пакети, които ви спестяват пари в сравнение с покупката на артикули поотделно. Свържете се с нашия екип по продажби за актуални промоции на пакети и цени на големи отстъпки.

bg::How should I store my inflatable SUP: Как да съхранявам надуваемия SUPси апарат?

bg::Inflatable boards offer portability,: Надуваемите дъски предлагат преносимост, удобство при съхранение и абсорбиране на удари. Твърдите дъски предлагат максимална твърдост и скорост. За повечето любители на развлечение, качествен надуваем с drop-stitch ядро е практичният избор.
bg::What wind speed is too high for SUP?: За коя скорост на вятъра е твърде SUPвисока?

bg::In-stock orders ship within 2–3 busi: Наличните поръчки се изпращат в рамките на 2–3 работни дни. Вътрешните поръчки в САЩ пристигат за 5–10 работни дни. Международните поръчки пристигат за 10–20 работни дни в зависимост от дестинацията. Спешните поръчки могат да бъдат ускорени.

bg::What paddle length do I need?: Каква дължина на греблото ми е нужна?

bg::What size engine do I need for a RIB: Какъв размер двигател ми трябва за RIB?

bg::What is the difference between PVC a: Каква е разликата между PVC и Hypalon?
bg::PVC is lighter, more affordable, and: PVC е по-лека, по-достъпна и по-лесна за ремонт — идеална за развлекателна употреба.Hypalon (CSM) предлага превъзходна UV и химическа устойчивост с по-дълъг живот, предпочитана за търговски и военни приложения. използваAquafarer и двете в зависимост от продукта.
bg::What SUP width is best for stability: Коя SUP ширина е най-добра за стабилност?
bg::For beginners, a width of 33–34 inch: За начинаещи ширина от 33–34 инча осигурява най-добрия баланс между стабилност и лекота при гребане. Дъски по-тесни над 32 инча се усещат като на върха за нови гребци. Aquafarer SUP Explorer 11 с дължина 33 инча е идеален за учене.
bg::How do I choose SUP volume for my we: Как да SUP избера обем за теглото си?
bg::Multiply your weight in kg by 2.2 fo: Умножете теглото си в кг по 2.2 за целева цел за обем, подходящ за начинаещи. Например, гребец с тегло 75 кг изисква поне 165 литра, но 220–260 литра е много по-стабилно за учене. SUP Explorer 11 предлага 260 литра, подходящи за колоездачи до 100 кг.
bg::What size engine do I need for my in: Какъв размер двигател ми е необходим за моята надуваема лодка?
За AirDeck 270 използвай до 6HP. За AirDeck 360 – до 15HP. За RIB 330 – до 40HP. За RIB патрул 450 – до 60HP. Винаги проверявай максималната HP оценителна табела на лодката си и никога не я надвишавай.
bg::What floor type is best for an infla: Какъв тип под е най-подходящ за надуваема лодка?
bg::Aluminum slat floors provide the bes: Алуминиевите решетъчни подове осигуряват най-добра производителност — твърди, подходящи за рендестиране и стабилни за стоене. Въздушните палуби са по-леки и са по-малки, но са по-гъвкави. Подовете с ролинг е най-простият и най-достъпен, но предлагат най-ниска твърдост. Избирайте според основното си предназначение: риболов и скорост предпочитат летвени подове; преносимостта предпочита въздушните палуби.
bg::How does Aquafarer compare to other: Как Aquafarer се сравнява с други марки?
bg::Aquafarer offers the best value in i: Aquafarer предлага най-добра стойност за надуваемо водно спортно оборудване. В сравнение с Red Paddle Co, Aquafarer осигурява 90% от производителността при 60% от цената. В сравнение с iRocker, Aquafarer използва по-висок клас тройна военна PVC и с по-високи PSI оценки. В сравнение с Bluefin, Aquafarer предлага по-добри материални характеристики. За повечето любители на гребци Aquafarer осигурява най-добрия баланс между качество и цена.
bg::Can I fish from a SUP board?: Мога ли да ловя риба от SUP дъска?
bg::Yes. SUP fishing is increasingly pop: Да.SUP Риболовът става все по-популярен, защото стоящото положение осигурява отлична видимост към водата. Изберете дъска с дължина поне 11 фута и ширина 33–34 инча за стабилност. Добавете млекарна клетка с държачи за въдици, закрепени на бунджитата на палубата, малка котва и винаги носете PFD. Aquafarer SUP Explorer 11 работи добре за неформален риболов.
bg::Can I do yoga on a SUP board?: Мога ли да правя йога на SUP дъска?
bg::Absolutely. SUP yoga combines tradit: Абсолютно.SUP Йога съчетава традиционни пози с предизвикателството на плаваща платформа, ангажираща по-дълбоки стабилизиращи мускули. Използвайте дъска с размер 33 инча или по-широка с мека, сцеплива подложка за палуба. Практикувайте в спокойна, плитка вода с котва. Започнете с основни пози като куче надолу, воин II и поза на дърво. SUP Explorer 11 с пълната EVA си подложка е много подходяща.
bg::What are the airline rules for trave: Какви са правилата на авиокомпанията за пътуване с надуваема SUPмашина?
bg::Most airlines accept SUP backpacks a: Повечето авиокомпании SUP приемат раници като регистриран багаж, ако са под 23–32 кг. Aquafarer Раницата е приблизително 90x40x30 см и тежи около 15 кг в опаковано състояние. Някои авиокомпании може да начисляват такси за прекомерно голям багаж. Пристигайте рано, увие плавници и помпа отделно в ръчния багаж и етикетирайте чантата като крехка. Винаги проучвайте политиката на авиокомпанията за спортно оборудване преди полет.
bg::What safety equipment do I need for: Какво защитно оборудване ми трябва за гребане със студена вода?
bg::Water below 15°C requires thermal pr: Вода под 15°C изисква термична защита. При 8–14°C използвайте неопренов костюм или сух костюм с ботуши, ръкавици и качулка. За 14–20°C е достатъчен 3/2 мм неопренов костюм. Винаги носете добре PFD прилепнал костюм за топлинна защита и безопасност. Проверете местните регулации за задължителни изисквания за оборудване.
bg::What are the minimum order quantitie: Какви са минималните количества за поръчки OEMза /ODM?
bg::Minimum order quantities (MOQs) vary: Минималните количества за поръчки MOQs() варират според типа продукта и сложността. Свържете се с нашия търговски екип с вашите изисквания за подробна оферта. Ние се занимаваме с всичко – от персонализирани цветове и лога до изцяло оригинални дизайни на калъпи.
bg::Can I put my own logo on Aquafarer p: Мога ли да сложа собственото си лого на Aquafarer продуктите?
bg::Yes. Our OEM service includes custom: Да. OEM Нашата услуга включва персонализирано поставяне на лого, цветови схеми и персонализирана опаковка. Предлагаме опции за печат с тампон, топлотрансфер и бродерия в зависимост от вида продукт. Изпратете вашите произведения и спецификации на нашия търговски екип за оферта и оценка на срока за изпълнение.
bg::What PSI should I inflate my SUP to?: На какво PSI да надуя SUP моята стойност?
bg::Inflate to the board's rated maximum: Надувайте до максималната стойност на PSI платката за най-добра производителност — обикновено 15–18 PSI за качествени SUPsнадуваеми машини. Aquafarer SUP Explorer 11 се представя най-добре при 15–18PSI. Недонадуването кара платката да се усеща мека и да се движи лошо. Прекомерното надуване над номиналния максимум рискува да повреди drop-stitch резбата. Проверете стикера близо до клапана за конкретната оценка на платката ви.
bg::How do I clean and maintain the EVA: Как да почистя и поддържам EVA подложката на палубата?
bg::Rinse the deck pad with fresh water: Изплаквайте подложката с прясна вода след всяка сесия. За мръсотия или петна използвайте мек сапун и мека четка — избягвайте агресивни химикали. Ако ръбовете започнат да се повдигат, нанесете малко водоустойчиво морско лепило и пресувайте под тежест 24 часа. Дръжте дъската извън UV директна загуба, когато не се използва, за да предотвратите разграждане.
bg::Yes. RIBs with rigid fiberglass or a: Да. RIBs с твърди корпуси от фибростъкло или алуминий изискват малък лодков транспортьор за пренос. Надуваемите тръби могат да се изпразнят за компактно съхранение, но твърдият корпус се нуждае от транспортьор. Серията AirDeck (напълно надуваема) не изисква транспортьор и може да се пренася в багажника на кола.
bg::Can I use a SUP board as a kayak?: Мога ли да използвам SUP дъска като каяк?
bg::Yes. Many SUP boards, including the: Да. Много SUP дъски, включително Aquafarer Explorer 11, имат D-пръстени, които позволяват монтаж на седалка за каяк. Използването на SUP с каяк седалка и еднолопастен гребло предлага комфортна позиция за седене за по-дълги преходи или риболов. Някои марки предлагат специални комплекти за преобразуване в каяк с седалки и по-дълги гребла.
bg::Do I need to rinse my inflatable boa: Трябва ли да изплаквам надуваемата си дъска след използване в океана?
bg::Yes — always rinse your board, fins,: Да — винаги изплаквайте дъската, плавниците, помпата и греблото с прясна вода след употреба в солена вода. Солените кристали проникват в шевовете и клапаните, причинявайки микро-фуги и корозия. Подсушете дъската на сянка преди изпразване и съхранение. Редовното изплакване значително удължава живота на вашия надуваем воден съд.
bg::Do I really need a leash for SUP?: Наистина ли ми е необходим предпазен шнур за SUP?
bg::Yes — always wear a leash. A coiled: Да — винаги носете предпазен шнур. Спираловиден SUP шнур се прикрепя към глезена или прасеца и държи дъската с вас при падане. В открити води предпазният шнур може да спаси живота ви, като предотврати отделянето от плаваемото устройство. За гребане по река, използвайте предпазен шнур с бързо освобождаване, за да избегнете заклещване.
bg::Is Aquafarer a trading company or a: Дали Aquafarer е търговска компания или производител?
bg::Neither a pure factory nor a trading: Нито чисто производство, нито търговска компания — Aquafarer LLC е бранд компания със собствен производствен център. Aquafarer LLC (Ню Мексико, САЩ) се занимава с глобално разпространение, договори, фактуриране и следпродажбено обслужване, докато Aquafarer Qingdao Manufacturing Hub управлява НИР, производство и контрол на качеството в собствено съоръжение от 12 000 м². Без посредници: всяка поръчка се изпраща директно от фабриката.
bg::Why is my contract with a US company: Защо моят договор е с американска компания, когато стоките се изпращат от Циндао?
bg::Aquafarer LLC (New Mexico, USA) is t: Aquafarer LLC (Ню Мексико, САЩ) е глобалният търговски субект, който подписва договори, издава фактури и предоставя следпродажбено обслужване, докато Qingdao Manufacturing Hub произвежда и изпраща всяка поръчка от FOB Циндао. Тази двойна структура на хъба поддържа стандарти за американско договаряне и разплащане, като същевременно запазва цени директно от фабриката и пълна прозрачност на производството.

et::Can I use it in the ocean?: Kas ma saan seda kasutada ookeanis?

et::How should I store my inflatable SUP: Kuidas ma peaksin oma täispuhutavat seadet SUPhoiustama?
et::Rinse with fresh water, dry complete: Loputa värske veega, kuivata täielikult, tühjenda täielikult, rulli nina juurest lahtiselt ja hoia kandekottis jahedas ja kuivas kohas, eemal otsesest päikesevalgusest. Ära kunagi hoia märjana ega äärmuslikes temperatuurides.
et::Inflatable boards offer portability,: Täispuhutavad lauad pakuvad kaasaskantavust, hoiustamise mugavust ja löökide neeldumist. Kõvad lauad pakuvad maksimaalset jäikust ja kiirust. Enamiku vaba aja kasutajate jaoks on praktiline valik kvaliteetne täispuhutav drop-stitch südamikuga raam.
et::What wind speed is too high for SUP?: Millise tuulekiiruse jaoks on liiga SUPsuur?

et::In-stock orders ship within 2–3 busi: Laos olevad tellimused saadetakse 2–3 tööpäeva jooksul. USA sisetellimused saabuvad 5–10 tööpäeva jooksul. Rahvusvahelised tellimused saabuvad 10–20 tööpäeva jooksul, sõltuvalt sihtkohast. Kiireloomulisi tellimusi saab kiirendada.

et::What paddle length do I need?: Millist aeru pikkust mul vaja on?

et::What is the difference between PVC a: Mis vahe PVC on ja Hypalonvahel?
et::PVC is lighter, more affordable, and: PVC on kergem, taskukohasem ja kergemini parandatav — ideaalne meelelahutuslikuks kasutamiseks.Hypalon (CSM) pakub UV paremat ja keemilist vastupidavust pikema eluiga, eelistatud nii kaubanduslikeks kui ka sõjalistes rakendustes.Aquafarer Kasutab mõlemat sõltuvalt tootetasemest.
et::What SUP width is best for stability: Milline SUP laius on stabiilsuse jaoks parim?
et::For beginners, a width of 33–34 inch: Algajatele pakub 33–34 tolli laius parima tasakaalu stabiilsuse ja aerutamise lihtsuse vahel. Kitsamad kui 32 tolli lauad tunduvad uutele aerutajatele otsas. Aquafarer SUP Explorer 11, 33 tolli pikk, on õppimiseks ideaalne.
et::How do I choose SUP volume for my we: Kuidas valida SUP maht oma kaalule?

et::What size engine do I need for my in: Mis suurusega mootorit mul on vaja oma täispuhutava paadi jaoks?
AirDeck 270 puhul kasuta kuni 6HP. AirDeck 360 puhul kuni 15HP. RIB 330 puhul kuni 40HP. RIB 450 patrulli puhul kuni 60HP. Kontrolli alati HP oma paadi maksimaalset reitingumärki ja ära ületa seda.
et::What floor type is best for an infla: Milline põrandatüüp on täispuhutava paadi jaoks parim?

et::How does Aquafarer compare to other: Kuidas Aquafarer see teiste brändidega võrreldes on?

et::Can I fish from a SUP board?: Kas ma võin kalastada SUP laualt?

et::Can I do yoga on a SUP board?: Kas ma saan teha joogat SUP laual?

et::What are the airline rules for trave: Millised on lennufirma reeglid täispuhutava lennukiga SUPreisimiseks?

et::What safety equipment do I need for: Millist turvavarustust vajan külma vee aerutamiseks?

et::What PSI should I inflate my SUP to?: Milleks PSI peaksin oma üles SUP puhuma?

et::Do I really need a leash for SUP?: Kas ma tõesti vajan SUP-le jalutusrihma?

he::Do I need a life vest on a SUP?: האם אני צריך אפוד הצלה עלSUP?

he::Do I need to register my inflatable: האם אני צריך לרשום את הסירה המתנפחת שלי?

id::Absolutely. SUP yoga combines tradit: Tentu saja.SUP Yoga menggabungkan pose tradisional dengan tantangan platform mengambang, mengaktifkan otot penstabil yang lebih dalam. Gunakan papan berukuran 33 inci atau lebih lebar dengan pad dek yang lembut dan mencengkeram. Berlatihlah di air yang tenang dan dangkal dengan jangkar. Mulailah dengan pose dasar seperti downward dog, warrior II, dan pose pohon. SUP Explorer 11 dengan EVA pad dek penuh sangat cocok.
id::What are the airline rules for trave: Apa aturan maskapai untuk bepergian dengan mobil tiupSUP?
id::Most airlines accept SUP backpacks a: Sebagian besar maskapai menerima SUP ransel sebagai bagasi terdaftar jika beratnya kurang dari 23–32 kg. Aquafarer Ransel ini berukuran sekitar 90x40x30 cm dan beratnya sekitar 15 kg saat dikemas. Beberapa maskapai mungkin mengenakan biaya bagasi berukuran besar. Tiba lebih awal, bungkus sirip dan pompa secara terpisah di dalam tas kabin, dan labeli tas sebagai rapuh. Selalu teliti kebijakan perlengkapan olahraga maskapai Anda sebelum terbang.
id::What safety equipment do I need for: Perlengkapan keselamatan apa yang saya butuhkan untuk mendayung di air dingin?
id::Water below 15°C requires thermal pr: Air di bawah 15°C memerlukan perlindungan termal. Untuk 8–14°C gunakan wetsuit atau drysuit dengan sepatu bot, sarung tangan, dan tudung. Untuk 14–20°C, wetsuit 3/2mm sudah cukup. Selalu kenakan pakaian yang pas PFD untuk perlindungan termal dan keselamatan. Periksa peraturan lokal untuk persyaratan perlengkapan wajib.
id::What are the minimum order quantitie: Berapa jumlah pesanan minimum untuk OEM/ODM?
id::Minimum order quantities (MOQs) vary: Jumlah pesanan minimum (MOQs) bervariasi tergantung jenis produk dan kompleksitas. Branding kustom pada model yang ada biasanya membutuhkan 5–10 unit. Desain lambung yang sepenuhnya kustom membutuhkan lebih tinggiMOQs. Hubungi tim penjualan kami dengan kebutuhan Anda untuk penawaran rinci. Kami menangani segala hal mulai dari warna dan logo kustom hingga desain cetakan yang sepenuhnya orisinal.
id::Can I put my own logo on Aquafarer p: Bisakah saya menempelkan logo saya sendiri pada Aquafarer produk?
id::Yes. Our OEM service includes custom: Ya. OEM Layanan kami mencakup penempatan logo khusus, skema warna khusus, dan kemasan khusus. Kami menawarkan pilihan padprinting, heat transfer, dan bordir tergantung pada jenis produk. Kirimkan karya seni dan spesifikasi Anda ke tim penjualan kami untuk mendapatkan penawaran dan estimasi waktu pengerjaan.
id::What PSI should I inflate my SUP to?: Ke mana PSI saya harus mengembang SUP ?
id::Inflate to the board's rated maximum: Tiup ke maksimum yang dinilai papan PSI untuk performa terbaik — biasanya 15–18 PSI untuk inflatable berkualitasSUPs. Aquafarer SUP Explorer 11 berkinerja terbaik pada 15–18PSI. Inflasi kurang membuat papan terasa lunak dan tidak mudah bergerak. Inflasi berlebihan melewati batas maksimum yang dinilai berisiko merusak drop-stitch ulir. Periksa stiker di dekat katup untuk mendapatkan rating spesifik papan Anda.
id::How do I clean and maintain the EVA: Bagaimana cara membersihkan dan merawat EVA deck pad?
id::Rinse the deck pad with fresh water: Bilas alas dek dengan air segar setelah setiap sesi. Untuk kotoran atau noda, gunakan sabun ringan dan sikat lembut — hindari bahan kimia yang keras. Jika tepi mulai terangkat, aplikasikan sedikit perekat laut tahan air dan tekan dengan berat selama 24 jam. Jaga papan agar tidak langsung UV terkena saat tidak digunakan untuk mencegah kerusakan alas pelindung.
id::Do I need a trailer for a RIB?: Apakah saya perlu trailer untuk RIB?
id::Yes. RIBs with rigid fiberglass or a: Ya. RIBs dengan lambung fiberglass kaku atau aluminium memerlukan trailer perahu kecil untuk transportasi. Tabung yang dapat dipompa dapat dikempiskan untuk penyimpanan yang ringkas, tetapi lambung kaku membutuhkan trailer. Seri AirDeck (sepenuhnya dapat dipompa) tidak memerlukan trailer dan dapat diangkut di bagasi mobil.
id::Can I use a SUP board as a kayak?: Bisakah saya menggunakan papan SUP sebagai kayak?
id::Yes. Many SUP boards, including the: Ya. Banyak papan SUP, termasuk Aquafarer Explorer 11, memiliki cincin-D yang memungkinkan pemasangan kursi kayak. Menggunakan SUP dengan kursi kayak dan dayung satu bilah menawarkan posisi duduk yang nyaman untuk perjalanan yang lebih panjang atau memancing. Beberapa merek menawarkan kit konversi kayak khusus dengan kursi dan dayung yang lebih panjang.
id::Do I need to rinse my inflatable boa: Apakah saya perlu membilas papan tiup saya setelah digunakan di laut?
id::Yes — always rinse your board, fins,: Ya — selalu bilas papan, sirip, pompa, dan dayung Anda dengan air tawar setelah digunakan di air asin. Kristal garam masuk ke celah dan katup, menyebabkan kebocoran mikro dan korosi. Keringkan papan di tempat teduh sebelum mengempiskan dan menyimpannya. Pembilasan secara teratur secara dramatis memperpanjang umur kendaraan air tiup Anda.
id::Do I really need a leash for SUP?: Apakah saya benar-benar perlu tali pengikat untuk SUP?
id::Yes — always wear a leash. A coiled: Ya — selalu kenakan tali pengikat. Tali pengikat SUP yang digulung dipasang di pergelangan kaki atau betis Anda dan menjaga papan tetap bersama Anda jika Anda jatuh. Di perairan terbuka, tali pengikat dapat menyelamatkan nyawa Anda dengan mencegah terpisah dari alat apung Anda. Untuk mendayung di sungai, gunakan tali pengikat pelepas cepat untuk mencegah terjebak.
id::Is Aquafarer a trading company or a: Aquafarer apakah perusahaan perdagangan atau produsen?
id::Neither a pure factory nor a trading: Bukan murni pabrik maupun perusahaan dagang — Aquafarer LLC adalah perusahaan merek dengan basis manufaktur sendiri. Aquafarer LLC (New Mexico, AS) menangani distribusi global, kontrak, penagihan, dan layanan purna jual, sementara Aquafarer Qingdao Manufacturing Hub menjalankan R&D, produksi, dan kontrol kualitas di fasilitas kami sendiri seluas 12.000 m². Tanpa perantara: setiap pesanan dikirim langsung dari pabrik.
id::Why is my contract with a US company: Mengapa kontrak saya dengan perusahaan AS ketika barang dikirim dari Qingdao?
id::Aquafarer LLC (New Mexico, USA) is t: Aquafarer LLC (New Mexico, AS) adalah entitas komersial global yang menandatangani kontrak, mengeluarkan faktur, dan memberikan dukungan purna jual, sementara Pusat Manufaktur Qingdao memproduksi dan mengirim setiap pesanan FOB Qingdao. Struktur dua pusat ini mempertahankan kontrak dan penyelesaian dengan standar AS, sambil menjaga harga langsung dari pabrik dan transparansi produksi penuh.
ko::Frequently asked questions about inf: 팽창식 SUP 보드, 카약, 딩기, RIBs안전 장비, 수상 스포츠에 관한 자주 묻는 질문들입니다.
ko::Not at all. Most beginners stand up: 전혀 그렇지 않습니다. 대부분의 초보자는 첫 세션에서 일어나 노를 젓습니다. 저희 올어라운드 SUP 시리즈는 처음 패들러를 위해 특별히 설계된 초넓은 안정 플랫폼을 제공합니다. 잔잔한 물에서 시작하면 몇 분 만에 크루징을 시작할 수 있습니다.
ko::Yes. Aquafarer SUP boards are built: 네.Aquafarer SUP 보드는 바다, 호수, 강 사용을 위해 만들어졌습니다. 저희 투어링 시리즈는 해안 파도 작업을 담당하며, 모든 보드는 PVC 해양 등급으로 해수 부식에 강합니다. 바다 사용 후에는 담수로 세척하세요.
ko::With the included dual-action pump,: 포함된 듀얼 액션 펌프를 사용하면 대부분의 보드가 5분 이내에 12–15까지 팽창합니다 PSI . 저희 전기 펌프 옵션은 이를 2분 이내로 단축시켜 줍니다. 디플레이션과 패킹 작업은 약 3분 만에 소요됩니다.
ko::Absolutely. Every Aquafarer board pa: 물론입니다. 모든 Aquafarer 보드는 편리하게 여행할 수 있도록 배낭 크기의 캐리어에 담겨 있습니다 — 캐리어 사이즈와 무게 정책을 꼭 확인하세요. 무게가 18-22파운드에 불과해 해변, 호수, 공항 터미널 등으로 쉽게 들고 다닐 수 있습니다.
ko::Our All-Around SUPs support up to 22: 저희 올어라운드 보 SUPs 트는 최대 220파운드까지 지원합니다. 투어링과 요가 시리즈는 최대 250파운드까지 지원하며, RIB 모델에 따라 보통 600–1500파운드까지 지원합니다. 탠덤 사용이나 무거운 짐을 위한 저희 고무선 보트는 더 큰 용량 옵션을 제공합니다.
ko::Every Aquafarer SUP includes the boa: 모든 모델 Aquafarer SUP 에는 보드, 여행용 백팩, 듀얼 액션 핸드 펌프, 탈착식 핀, 코일 리쉬, 수리 키트가 포함되어 있습니다. 일부 모델은 카본 패들 업그레이드 옵션도 포함되어 있습니다. 팽창식 보트에는 보트, 펌프, 수리 키트, 노가 포함되어 있습니다.
ko::Yes. We offer curated bundles that s: 네. 별도로 구매하는 것보다 비용을 절감할 수 있는 엄선된 번들을 제공합니다. 현재 번들 프로모션과 대량 할인 가격은 영업팀에 문의해 주세요.
ko::Yes. Many jurisdictions legally requ: 네. 많은 관할 구역에서는 모든 수상 선박에 구명조끼를 법적으로 요구하고 SUPs있습니다. 필수가 아니더라도 CE인증된 구명조끼는 필수 안전 장비입니다. 우리는 항상 물 위에서 구명조끼를 착용할 것을 권장합니다.
ko::Requirements vary by jurisdiction. I: 요건은 관할 구역마다 다릅니다. 대부분의 지역에서는 일정 마력 이상의 엔진을 장착한 팽창선은 등록이 필요합니다. 동력 없는 소형 SUPs 딩기는 보통 등록이 필요하지 않습니다. 구체적인 규정은 지역 해사 당국을 확인하세요.
ko::Clean the area, cut a patch with rou: 부위를 청소하고, 둥근 모서리가 있는 패치를 자르고, 접착제를 바른 PVC 뒤 단단히 눌러서 24시간 기다렸다가 부풀립니다.Aquafarer 보드에는 수리 키트가 포함되어 있습니다. 자세한 방법은 저희 팽창식 수리 가이드를 참고하세요.
ko::Rinse with fresh water, dry complete: 신선한 물로 헹구고 완전히 말린 후 완전히 공기가 빠진 후 코에서 느슨하게 굴려 휴대 가방에 넣어 직사광선이 닿지 않는 서늘하고 건조한 곳에 보관하세요. 절대 젖은 상태나 극한 온도에서 보관하지 마세요.
ko::Inflatable or hard SUP board?: 팽창식 보드 아니면 단단 SUP 한 보드 중 어느 쪽이 좋을까요?
ko::Inflatable boards offer portability,: 인플레이션 보드는 휴대성, 수납 편리함, 충격 흡수 능력을 제공합니다. 하드 보드는 최대한의 강성과 속도를 제공합니다. 대부분의 레크리에이션 사용자에게 핵심이 포함된 고품질 인플레이터블 drop-stitch 이 실용적인 선택입니다.
ko::Beginners: over 10 mph (8 knots). In: 초급: 10mph 이상(8노트). 중급: 15mph (13노트) 이상. 고급: 20mph (17노트) 이상. 의심스러우면 나가지 마세요. 해안에서 바다로 불어오는 해상 바람은 모든 실력에서 위험합니다.
ko::All Aquafarer products are backed by: 모든 Aquafarer 제품은 포괄적인 제조사 보증이 제공됩니다. 인플레이터블 튜브 보트의 원단, 솔기, 선체는 5년 제한 보증이 적용되며;SUP 보드 및 액세서리는 2년 제한 보증이 적용됩니다. 보증은 일반 사용 시 재료 및 시공 결함도 보장합니다.
ko::File a claim by contacting our suppo: 주문 번호, 문제 사진, 간단한 설명을 첨부하여 지원팀에 연락하여 청구를 제출하세요. 대부분의 청구는 영업일 2일 이내에 검토됩니다. 승인된 청구는 며칠 내에 교체 또는 수리 지침을 받습니다.
ko::In-stock orders ship within 2–3 busi: 재고 주문은 2–3영업일 내에 배송됩니다. 미국 국내 주문은 5–10영업일 내에 도착합니다. 국제 주문은 목적지에 따라 10–20영업일 내에 도착합니다. 긴급 주문은 신속 처리가 가능합니다.
ko::We accept returns within 30 days of: 저희는 원래 포장된 미사용 제품에 대해 배송 후 30일 이내에 반품을 받습니다. 맞춤OEM 주문은 반품이 불가합니다. 반품을 시작하려면 저희 지원팀에 연락해 주세요 — 선불 배송 라벨을 제공합니다.
ko::Yes. We offer private label and cust: 네. 저희는 기업을 위한 프라이셜 라벨 및 맞춤형 디자인 서비스를 제공합니다. 기존 모델의 맞춤형 브랜딩부터 완전 맞춤형 선체 디자인까지, 저희 엔지니어링 팀이 귀사의 브랜드 아래 제품을 개발할 수 있습니다. 최소 주문량이 적용됩니다.
ko::For SUP: the paddle should be 6–8 in: 예를 들어SUP: 패들은 당신의 키보다 6–8인치 더 높아야 합니다. 카약의 경우: 패들 길이는 보트 너비와 몸통 길이에 따라 달라집니다. 자세한 사이즈는 저희 패들 가이드를 참고하세요.
ko::Engine size depends on boat length a: 엔진 크기는 보트 길이와 무게에 따라 달라집니다. 3m는 RIB 보통 15–25mphHP, 4.5m는 RIB 40–60mphHP, 6m는 RIB 90–150mph를 처리HP합니다. 항상 HP 보트의 최대 등급 번호판을 따라야 합니다.
ko::What is the difference between PVC a: 와 의 차이가 무엇인가요 PVC Hypalon?
ko::PVC is lighter, more affordable, and: PVC 더 가볍고, 저렴하며, 수리가 용이하여 레크리에이션 용도에 이상적입니다.Hypalon (CSM) 제품은 우수한 UV 화학적 저항성을 제공하며 수명이 길어 상업 및 군사 용도에 선호됩니다.Aquafarer 제품 등급에 따라 두 가지 모두 사용됩니다.
ko::What SUP width is best for stability: SUP 안정성을 위해 가장 좋은 폭은 무엇인가요?
ko::For beginners, a width of 33–34 inch: 초보자에게는 33–34인치 폭이 안정성과 패들링의 용이함의 균형을 이룹니다. 32인치보다 좁은 보드는 초보자에게 약간 넘어지는 느낌을 줍니다. Aquafarer SUP 익스플로러 11은 33인치 길이로 학습하기에 이상적입니다.
ko::How do I choose SUP volume for my we: SUP 내 체중에 맞는 볼륨을 어떻게 선택하나요?
ko::Multiply your weight in kg by 2.2 fo: 초보자에게 적합한 볼륨 목표를 위해 kg에 kg을 곱하세요. 예를 들어, 75kg의 패들러는 최소 165리터가 필요하지만, 220–260리터가 학습에 훨씬 더 안정적입니다. SUP 익스플로러 11은 최대 100kg의 라이더에게 적합한 260리터를 제공합니다.
ko::What size engine do I need for my in: 내 고무보트에 필요한 엔진 크기는 얼마인가요?
AirDeck 270 등급은 최대 6 HP. AirDeck 360 등급은 최대 15 HP등급 . RIB 330등급은 최대 40등급 HP. RIB 450등급 순찰 등급은 최대 60등급 HP. 항상 HP 보트의 최대 등급 번호판을 확인하고 절대 초과하지 마세요.
ko::What floor type is best for an infla: 인플레이터블 보트에 가장 적합한 바닥 유형은 무엇인가요?
ko::Aluminum slat floors provide the bes: 알루미늄 슬랫 플로어는 최고의 성능을 제공합니다 — 단단하고, 대패질이 가능하며, 서 있어도 안정적입니다. 에어 데크는 더 가볍고 적재량도 작지만 더 많이 굽습니다. 롤업 플로어는 가장 단순하고 저렴하지만 강성은 가장 낮습니다. 주요 용도에 따라 선택하세요: 낚시와 속도가 슬랫 플로어를 선호하고; 휴대성이 에어 데크를 선호합니다.
ko::Aquafarer offers the best value in i: Aquafarer 인플레이션 수상 스포츠 장비 중 최고의 가성비를 제공합니다. 레드 패들 컴퍼니와 비교했을 때, Aquafarer 90%의 성능을 60%의 비용으로 제공합니다. 아이로커와 비교했을 때, 더 Aquafarer 높은 등급의 삼중 군용 등급 및 등급을 사용합니다 PVC PSI . 블루핀과 비교했을 때 Aquafarer 우수한 소재 사양을 제공합니다. 대부분의 레크리에이션 패들러에게 품질 Aquafarer 과 가격 균형이 가장 좋습니다.

sl::Can I fish from a SUP board?: Ali lahko ribarim z SUP desko?

sl::What safety equipment do I need for: Kakšno varnostno opremo potrebujem za veslanje v hladni vodi?

sl::Yes. RIBs with rigid fiberglass or a: Da. Pri trdihRIBs trupih iz steklenih ali aluminijastih vlaken je za prevoz potrebna majhna prikolica za čoln. Prilagođeno brendiranje na postojećim modelima obično zahteva 5–10 jedinica. Potpuno prilagođeni dizajn trupa zahteva višeMOQs. Kontaktirajte naš prodajni tim sa vašim zahtevima za detaljnu ponudu. Mi se bavimo svime, od prilagođenih boja i logotipa do potpuno originalnih dizajna kalupa.
sr::Can I put my own logo on Aquafarer p: Mogu li da stavim svoj logo na Aquafarer proizvode?
sr::Yes. Our OEM service includes custom: Da. Naša OEM usluga uključuje postavljanje prilagođenog logotipa, prilagođene šeme boja i prilagođeno pakovanje. Nudimo opcije za tampon štampu, prenos toplote i vez u zavisnosti od vrste proizvoda. Pošaljite svoje umetničko delo i specifikacije našem prodajnom timu za ponudu i procenu vremena.
sr::What PSI should I inflate my SUP to?: Na šta PSI treba da naduvam SUP ?
sr::Inflate to the board's rated maximum: Naduvavanje na ocijenjeni maksimum ploče PSI za najbolje performanse — obično 15–18 PSI za kvalitet na naduvavanjeSUPs. Aquafarer SUP Ekplorer 11 najbolje obavlja na 15–18PSI. Nedovoljno naduvavanje uzrokuje da se ploča oseća meko i slabo prati. Prekomerna inflacija pored ocenjenog maksimuma drop-stitch rizikuje oštećenje tema. Proverite nalepnicu u blizini ventila za specifičnu ocenu vašeg odbora.
sr::How do I clean and maintain the EVA: Kako da očistim i održavam EVA podlogu za palubu?
sr::Rinse the deck pad with fresh water: Isperite podlogu za palubu svežom vodom nakon svake sesije. Za prljavštinu ili mrlje koristite blagi sapun i meku četku - izbegavajte jake hemikalije. Ako ivice počnu da se podižu, nanesite malu količinu vodootpornog morskog lepka i pritisnite pod težinom 24 sata. Držite ploču van direktnog UV kada se ne koristi kako biste sprečili degradaciju jastučića.
sr::Do I need a trailer for a RIB?: Da li mi treba prikolica zaRIB?
sr::Yes. RIBs with rigid fiberglass or a: Da.RIBs Sa krutim fiberglasa ili aluminijumskih trupova zahtevaju malu prikolicu za brod za transport. Cevi na naduvavanje mogu se ispuhati za kompaktno skladištenje, ali kruti trup treba prikolicu. AirDeck Serija (potpuno na naduvavanje) ne zahteva prikolicu i može se transportovati u prtljažniku automobila.
sr::Can I use a SUP board as a kayak?: Mogu li da koristim SUP dasku kao kajak?
sr::Yes. Many SUP boards, including the: Da. Mnogi SUP odbori, uključujući Aquafarer i Ekplorer 11, imaju D-prstenove koji omogućavaju pričvršćivanje sedišta kajaka. Korišćenje SUP sa sedištem kajaka i veslom sa jednom oštricom nudi udoban položaj sedenja za duža putovanja ili ribolov. Neki brendovi nude namenske komplete za konverziju kajaka sa sedištima i dužim veslima.
sr::Do I need to rinse my inflatable boa: Da li treba da isperem dasku na naduvavanje nakon upotrebe okeana?
sr::Yes — always rinse your board, fins,: Da - uvek isperite dasku, peraja, pumpu i veslo svežom vodom nakon upotrebe slane vode. Kristali soli rade u šavovima i ventilima, uzrokujući mikro-curenje i koroziju. Osušite ploču u hladu pre ispuhivanja i skladištenja. Redovno ispiranje dramatično produžava život vašeg plovila na naduvavanje.
sr::Do I really need a leash for SUP?: Da li mi zaista treba povodac zaSUP?
sr::Yes — always wear a leash. A coiled: Da - uvek nosite povodac. Namotani SUP povodac se pričvršćuje na vaš gležanj ili tele i drži dasku sa vama ako padnete. U otvorenim vodama, povodac može spasiti vaš život sprečavanjem odvajanja od vašeg plutajućeg uređaja. Za reku veslanje, koristite povodac za brzo otpuštanje kako biste sprečili zarobljavanje.
sr::Is Aquafarer a trading company or a: Da li je Aquafarer trgovačko preduzeće ili proizvođač?
sr::Neither a pure factory nor a trading: Ni čista fabrika ni trgovačko preduzeće — Aquafarer LLC je brend kompanija sa sopstvenom proizvodnom bazom.Aquafarer LLC (Novi Meksiko, SAD) bavi se globalnom distribucijom, ugovorima, naplatom i postprodajom, dok Aquafarer Kingdao Manufacturing Hub vodi istraživanje i razvoj, proizvodnju i kontrolu kvaliteta u našem objektu od 12.000 m². Nema posrednika: svaka narudžba se šalje direktno u fabrici.
sr::Why is my contract with a US company: Zašto je moj ugovor sa američkom kompanijom kada se roba isporučuje iz Kingdaoa?
sr::Aquafarer LLC (New Mexico, USA) is t: Aquafarer LLC (Novi Meksiko, SAD) je globalni komercijalni subjekt koji potpisuje ugovore, izdaje fakture i pruža podršku nakon prodaje, dok Kingdao Manufacturing Hub proizvodi i otprema svaku narudžbu FOB Kingdao. Ova struktura sa dvostrukim čvorištem održava američko standardno ugovaranje i poravnanje, uz očuvanje fabričkih direktnih cena i potpune transparentnosti proizvodnje.

th::Can I use it in the ocean?: ฉันใช้มันในทะเลได้ไหม?

th::How long does it take to inflate?: ใช้เวลานานแค่ไหนในการพองตัว?

th::Can I travel with an inflatable SUP?: ฉันสามารถเดินทางพร้อมเรือเป่าลมSUPได้ไหม?

th::What is the weight limit?: น้ําหนักสูงสุดคือเท่าไหร่?

th::What comes in the box?: ในกล่องมีอะไรบ้าง?

th::Do I need a life vest on a SUP?: ฉันจําเป็นต้องใส่เสื้อชูชีพไหมSUP?

th::Do I need to register my inflatable: ฉันจําเป็นต้องลงทะเบียนเรือเป่าลมของฉันหรือไม่?

th::How do I repair a puncture?: ฉันจะซ่อมแซมรอยรั่วได้อย่างไร?

th::What wind speed is too high for SUP?: ความเร็วลมแบบไหนถึงจะสูงเกินไปSUPสําหรับ?

th::What paddle length do I need?: ฉันต้องใช้ความยาวไม้พายเท่าไหร่?
th::For SUP: the paddle should be 6–8 in: สําหรับSUP: ไม้พายควรสูงกว่าความสูงของคุณ 6–8 นิ้วสําหรับเรือคายัค: ความยาวไม้พายขึ้นอยู่กับความกว้างของเรือและความยาวลําตัวดูคู่มือไม้พายของเราสําหรับขนาดรายละเอียด
th::What size engine do I need for a RIB: ฉันต้องใช้เครื่องยนต์ขนาดไหนRIBสําหรับ ?
th::Engine size depends on boat length a: ขนาดเครื่องยนต์ขึ้นอยู่กับความยาวและน้ําหนักของเรือ 3m RIB โดยทั่วไปรองรับ 15–25 นิ้วHP, 4.5m RIB รองรับ 40–60 นิ้ว HPและ 6m RIB รองรับ 90–150 HPต้องปฏิบัติตามHPป้ายสูงสุดของเรือเสมอ
th::What is the difference between PVC a: ความแตกต่างระหว่าง PVC กับ Hypalonคืออะไร?
th::PVC is lighter, more affordable, and: PVC มีน้ําหนักเบากว่า ราคาย่อมเยากว่า และซ่อมแซมง่ายกว่า — เหมาะสําหรับการใช้งานเพื่อสันทนาการHypalon(CSM) ให้ความUVทนทานต่อสารเคมีที่เหนือกว่า พร้อมอายุการใช้งานที่ยาวนาน เหมาะสําหรับการใช้งานเชิงพาณิชย์และทหารAquafarerใช้ทั้งสองประเภทขึ้นอยู่กับระดับผลิตภัณฑ์
th::What SUP width is best for stability: ความกว้างแบบไหนSUPถึงจะมั่นคงที่สุด?
th::For beginners, a width of 33–34 inch: สําหรับผู้เริ่มต้น ความกว้าง 33–34 นิ้วให้สมดุลที่ดีที่สุดระหว่างความมั่นคงและความง่ายในการพายบอร์ดที่แคบกว่า 32 นิ้วจะรู้สึกเอียงสําหรับผู้เริ่มต้น Aquafarer SUP Explorer 11 ที่ 33 นิ้วเหมาะสําหรับการเรียนรู้
th::How do I choose SUP volume for my we: ฉันจะเลือกSUPปริมาตรสําหรับน้ําหนักของฉันได้อย่างไร?
th::Multiply your weight in kg by 2.2 fo: คูณน้ําหนักเป็นกิโลกรัมด้วย 2.2 เพื่อเป้าหมายปริมาตรที่เหมาะสําหรับผู้เริ่มต้นตัวอย่างเช่น นักพายน้ําหนัก 75 กก. ต้องการอย่างน้อย 165 ลิตร แต่ 220–260 ลิตรถือว่ามั่นคงกว่าสําหรับการเรียนรู้ SUP Explorer 11 มีความจุ 260 ลิตร เหมาะสําหรับผู้ขี่น้ําหนักไม่เกิน 100 กิโลกรัม
th::What size engine do I need for my in: ฉันต้องใช้เครื่องยนต์ขนาดเท่าไรสําหรับเรือเป่าลมของฉัน?
สําหรับ AirDeck 270 ให้ใช้สูงสุด 6 HP.สําหรับ AirDeck 360 ใช้สูงสุด 15 HP.สําหรับ RIB 330 ใช้สูงสุด 40 HP.สําหรับ RIB 450 Patrol ให้ใช้สูงสุด 60 HP.ตรวจสอบHPแผ่นคะแนนสูงสุดบนเรือเสมอ และอย่าเกิน
th::What floor type is best for an infla: พื้นเรือแบบไหนดีที่สุดสําหรับเรือเป่าลม?
th::Aluminum slat floors provide the bes: พื้นอลูมิเนียมแบบแผ่นไม้ให้ประสิทธิภาพสูงสุด — แข็งแรง ไสได้ และมั่นคงสําหรับการยืนพื้นแอร์มีน้ําหนักเบาและเก็บของได้น้อยกว่าแต่ยืดหยุ่นมากกว่าพื้นแบบม้วนขึ้นเป็นแบบที่เรียบง่ายและราคาถูกที่สุด แต่มีความแข็งน้อยที่สุดเลือกตามการใช้งานหลักของคุณ: การตกปลาและความเร็วเหมาะกับพื้นแบบแร็ต;ความสะดวกในการพกพาเหมาะกับพื้นแอร์เด็ค
th::How does Aquafarer compare to other: เปรียบเทียบAquafarerกับแบรนด์อื่นอย่างไร?
th::Aquafarer offers the best value in i: Aquafarer มอบความคุ้มค่าสูงสุดในอุปกรณ์กีฬาทางน้ําเป่าลมเมื่อเทียบกับ Red Paddle Co ให้ประสิทธิภาพถึง Aquafarer 90% ในราคาเพียง 60% ของต้นทุนเมื่อเทียบกับ iRocker Aquafarer ใช้เกรดทหารสามชั้นคุณภาพสูงPVCกว่าและคะแนนที่สูงกว่าPSIเมื่อเทียบกับ Bluefin Aquafarer มีสเปกวัสดุที่เหนือกว่าสําหรับนักพายเพื่อสันทนาการส่วนใหญ่ Aquafarer ให้สมดุลที่ดีที่สุดระหว่างคุณภาพและราคา
th::Can I fish from a SUP board?: ฉันสามารถตกปลาจากบอร์ดได้SUPไหม?
th::Yes. SUP fishing is increasingly pop: ใช่SUPการตกปลาได้รับความนิยมมากขึ้นเพราะท่ายืนช่วยให้มองเห็นน้ําได้ดีเลือกบอร์ดที่ยาวอย่างน้อย 11 ฟุต และกว้าง 33–34 นิ้วเพื่อความมั่นคงเพิ่มลังนมที่มีที่ยึดคันเบ็ดติดกับบังจี้บนดาดฟ้า สมอเล็ก ๆ และสวม PFD.Aquafarer SUP Explorer 11 เหมาะกับการตกปลาทั่วไป
th::Can I do yoga on a SUP board?: ฉันเล่นโยคะบนบอร์ดได้SUPไหม?
th::Absolutely. SUP yoga combines tradit: แน่นอนSUPโยคะผสมผสานท่าทางแบบดั้งเดิมกับความท้าทายของแพลตฟอร์มลอยน้ํา โดยใช้กล้ามเนื้อที่ช่วยเสถียรลึกขึ้นใช้บอร์ดที่กว้างกว่า 33 นิ้ว พร้อมแผ่นรองดาดฟ้าที่นุ่มและยึดเกาะได้ดีฝึกในน้ําตื้นและสงบพร้อมสมอเรือเริ่มด้วยท่าพื้นฐาน เช่น ท่า downward dog, warrior II และท่าต้นไม้ SUP Explorer 11 ที่มีEVAแผ่นรองดาดฟ้าเต็มตัวเหมาะสมอย่างยิ่ง
th::What are the airline rules for trave: กฎของสายการบินสําหรับการเดินทางด้วยเรือเป่าลมSUPเป็นอย่างไร?
th::Most airlines accept SUP backpacks a: สายการบินส่วนใหญ่รับSUPกระเป๋าเป้เป็นสัมภาระโหลดใต้เครื่องถ้าน้ําหนักต่ํากว่า 23–32 กก.Aquafarerกระเป๋าเป้มีขนาดประมาณ 90x40x30 ซม. และน้ําหนักประมาณ 15 กก. เมื่อบรรจุบางสายการบินอาจคิดค่าธรรมเนียมสัมภาระขนาดใหญ่มาถึงก่อนเวลา พันครีบและปั๊มนมแยกในกระเป๋าถือขึ้นเครื่อง และติดป้ายว่ากระเป๋าเปราะบางควรศึกษานโยบายอุปกรณ์กีฬาของสายการบินก่อนขึ้นเครื่องเสมอ
th::What safety equipment do I need for: ฉันต้องใช้อุปกรณ์ความปลอดภัยอะไรบ้างสําหรับการพายน้ําเย็น?
th::Water below 15°C requires thermal pr: ถ้ามีน้ําต่ํากว่า 15°C ต้องได้รับการป้องกันความร้อนสําหรับอุณหภูมิ 8–14°C ให้ใส่ชุดเว็ทสูทหรือชุดดรายสูทพร้อมรองเท้าบูท ถุงมือ และฮู้ดสําหรับอุณหภูมิ 14–20°C ใช้ชุดเว็ทสูทขนาด 3/2 มม. ก็เพียงพอแล้วควรสวมชุดเว็ทสูทที่พอดีตัวPFDเพื่อการป้องกันความร้อนและความปลอดภัยตรวจสอบข้อบังคับท้องถิ่นเกี่ยวกับข้อกําหนดอุปกรณ์ที่จําเป็น
th::What are the minimum order quantitie: ปริมาณขั้นต่ําในการสั่งซื้อสําหรับ OEM/ODM?
th::Minimum order quantities (MOQs) vary: จํานวนสั่งซื้อขั้นต่ํา (MOQs) จะแตกต่างกันไปตามประเภทสินค้าและความซับซ้อนการสร้างแบรนด์แบบกําหนดเองในโมเดลที่มีอยู่มักต้องใช้ 5–10 ชิ้นการออกแบบตัวเรือแบบสั่งทําเต็มรูปแบบต้องการจํานวนมากกว่าMOQsติดต่อทีมขายของเราพร้อมความต้องการของคุณเพื่อขอใบเสนอราคาอย่างละเอียดเราดูแลทุกอย่างตั้งแต่สีและโลโก้แบบกําหนดเองไปจนถึงการออกแบบแม่พิมพ์ต้นฉบับทั้งหมด
th::Can I put my own logo on Aquafarer p: ฉันสามารถใส่โลโก้ของตัวเองบนAquafarerสินค้าได้ไหม?
th::Yes. Our OEM service includes custom: ใช่OEMบริการของเรารวมถึงการวางโลโก้แบบกําหนดเอง โทนสีที่กําหนดเอง และบรรจุภัณฑ์แบบกําหนดเองเรามีบริการพิมพ์แผ่น การถ่ายเทความร้อน และงานปักขึ้นอยู่กับประเภทสินค้าส่งงานศิลปะและสเปกของคุณไปยังทีมขายของเราเพื่อขอใบเสนอราคาและประมาณระยะเวลาการผลิต
th::What PSI should I inflate my SUP to?: ควรPSIเติมลม SUP TO0 เท่าไหร่ดี?
th::Inflate to the board's rated maximum: เป่าลมให้ถึงค่าสูงสุดที่กําหนดของบอร์ดPSIเพื่อประสิทธิภาพสูงสุด — โดยทั่วไป 15–18 PSI สําหรับยางเป่าลมคุณภาพ SUPsAquafarer SUP Explorer 11 ทํางานได้ดีที่สุดที่ 15–18 PSIถ้าเติมลมต่ําเกินไปจะทําให้บอร์ดรู้สึกนุ่มและเดินช้าถ้าเติมลมเกินค่าที่กําหนดไว้เสี่ยงต่อdrop-stitchการทําลายเกลียวตรวจสอบสติกเกอร์ใกล้วาล์วเพื่อดูคะแนนเฉพาะของบอร์ด
th::How do I clean and maintain the EVA: ฉันจะทําความสะอาดและดูแลEVAแผ่นรองพื้นได้อย่างไร?
th::Rinse the deck pad with fresh water: ล้างแผ่นรองพื้นด้วยน้ําสะอาดหลังจากแต่ละครั้งที่ทําสําหรับคราบสกปรกหรือคราบ ให้ใช้สบู่อ่อนและแปรงนุ่ม — หลีกเลี่ยงสารเคมีรุนแรงหากขอบเริ่มลอก ให้ทากาวกันน้ําปริมาณเล็กน้อยแล้วกดใต้น้ําหนักเป็นเวลา 24 ชั่วโมงเก็บแผ่นไม้ให้ไม่สัมผัสกับพื้นโดยตรงUVเมื่อไม่ได้ใช้งานเพื่อป้องกันการเสื่อมสภาพของแผ่นรอง
th::Do I need a trailer for a RIB?: ฉันจําเป็นต้องมีรถพ่วงสําหรับ RIB?
th::Yes. RIBs with rigid fiberglass or a: ใช่ RIBs ที่มีตัวเรือทำจากไฟเบอร์กลาสแข็งหรืออะลูมิเนียมต้องใช้รถพ่วงเรือขนาดเล็กสำหรับการขนส่ง ท่อยางเป่าลมสามารถยุบเพื่อเก็บให้กะทัดรัดได้ แต่ตัวเรือแข็งจำเป็นต้องใช้รถพ่วง ชุด AirDeck (แบบเป่าลมเต็มรูปแบบ) ไม่ต้องใช้รถพ่วงและสามารถขนส่งในท้ายรถได้
th::Can I use a SUP board as a kayak?: ฉันสามารถใช้บอร์ด SUP เป็นเรือคายัคได้ไหม?
th::Yes. Many SUP boards, including the: ใช่ หลายบอร์ด SUP รวมถึง Aquafarer Explorer 11 มี D-ring ที่อนุญาตให้ติดตั้งที่นั่งคายัค การใช้ SUP กับที่นั่งคายัคและไม้พายใบเดียวให้ท่านั่งที่สะดวกสบายสำหรับการเดินทางหรือการตกปลาที่ยาวนานขึ้น บางแบรนด์มีชุดแปลงคายัคเฉพาะที่มาพร้อมที่นั่งและไม้พายที่ยาวกว่า
th::Do I need to rinse my inflatable boa: ฉันจำเป็นต้องล้างกระดานเป่าลมของฉันหลังจากใช้งานในทะเลหรือไม่?
th::Yes — always rinse your board, fins,: ใช่ — ล้างกระดาน ครีบ ปั๊ม และไม้พายด้วยน้ำจืดทุกครั้งหลังจากใช้ในน้ำเค็ม ผลึกเกลือจะเข้าไปในรอยต่อและวาล์ว ทำให้เกิดการรั่วไหลเล็กน้อยและการกัดกร่อน ทำให้กระดานแห้งในที่ร่มก่อนที่จะลดลมและเก็บ การล้างเป็นประจำช่วยยืดอายุการใช้งานของเรือเป่าลมของคุณอย่างมาก
th::Do I really need a leash for SUP?: ฉันจำเป็นต้องใช้สายจูงสำหรับ SUP จริง ๆ หรือ?
th::Yes — always wear a leash. A coiled: ใช่ — ควรใส่สายจูงตลอดเวลา สายจูงแบบม้วน SUP สามารถติดกับข้อเท้าหรือหน้าแข้งของคุณและช่วยให้บอร์ดอยู่กับคุณหากคุณล้ม ในน้ำเปิด สายจูงสามารถช่วยชีวิตคุณได้โดยป้องกันไม่ให้คุณแยกจากอุปกรณ์ลอยตัว สำหรับการพายเรือแม่น้ำ ให้ใช้สายจูงแบบปลดออกเร็วเพื่อป้องกันการติดขัด
th::Is Aquafarer a trading company or a: Aquafarer เป็นบริษัทการค้าหรือผู้ผลิต?
th::Neither a pure factory nor a trading: ไม่ใช่โรงงานล้วน ๆ และไม่ใช่บริษัทการค้า — Aquafarer LLC เป็นบริษัทแบรนด์ที่มีฐานการผลิตของตัวเอง Aquafarer LLC (นิวเม็กซิโก, สหรัฐอเมริกา) ดูแลการจัดจำหน่ายทั่วโลก สัญญา การเรียกเก็บเงิน และการบริการหลังการขาย ขณะที่ Aquafarer Qingdao Manufacturing Hub ดำเนินการวิจัยและพัฒนา การผลิต และการควบคุมคุณภาพในโรงงานของเราเองที่มีพื้นที่ 12,000 ตารางเมตร ไม่มีคนกลาง: ทุกคำสั่งซื้อจัดส่งตรงจากโรงงาน
th::Why is my contract with a US company: ทำไมสัญญาของฉันกับบริษัทสหรัฐอเมริกาถึงเป็นเมื่อสินค้าจัดส่งมาจากชิงเต่า?
th::Aquafarer LLC (New Mexico, USA) is t: บริษัท Aquafarer LLC (นิวเม็กซิโก, สหรัฐอเมริกา) เป็นหน่วยงานเชิงพาณิชย์ระดับโลกที่ลงนามในสัญญา ออกใบแจ้งหนี้ และให้การสนับสนุนหลังการขาย ในขณะที่ศูนย์การผลิตชิงเต่าผลิตและจัดส่งคำสั่งซื้อทุกรายการจาก FOB ชิงเต่า โครงสร้างสองศูนย์นี้ช่วยให้การทำสัญญาและการชำระเงินเป็นไปตามมาตรฐานสหรัฐอเมริกา ในขณะที่ยังคงราคาระดับโรงงานโดยตรงและมีความโปร่งใสเต็มรูปแบบในการผลิต

tl::What are the airline rules for trave: Ano ang mga patakaran ng airline para sa paglalakbay gamit ang inflatableSUP?

Garanti, normal kullanımda malzeme ve işçilikteki kusurları kapsar.
tr::File a claim by contacting our suppo: Sipariş numaranız, sorunun fotoğrafları ve kısa bir açıklama ile destek ekibimizle iletişime geçerek bir talep oluşturun. Çoğu talep 2 iş günü içinde incelenir. Onaylanmış talepler birkaç gün içinde yenileme veya tamir talimatı alır.
tr::In-stock orders ship within 2–3 busi: Stokta olan siparişler 2–3 iş günü içinde gönderilir. ABD iç siparişleri 5–10 iş günü içinde gelir. Uluslararası siparişler varış noktasına bağlı olarak 10–20 iş günü içinde gelir. Acil siparişler hızlandırılabilir.
tr::We accept returns within 30 days of: Orijinal ambalajda kullanılmamış ürünler için teslimattan sonraki 30 gün içinde iadeleri kabul ediyoruz. Özel siparişlerOEM iade edilemez. İadeyi başlatmak için destek ekibimizle iletişime geçin — ön ödemeli kargo etiketi sağlıyoruz.
tr::Yes. We offer private label and cust: Evet. İşletmeler için özel etiket ve özel tasarım hizmetleri sunuyoruz. Mevcut modellerde özel markalamadan tamamen özel gövde tasarımlarına kadar, mühendislik ekibimiz markanız altında ürünler geliştirebilir. Asgari sipariş miktarları uygulanır.
tr::For SUP: the paddle should be 6–8 in: IçinSUP: Kürek yüksekliğinizden 6–8 inç daha yüksek olmalıdır. Kayak için: kürek uzunluğu tekne genişliğine ve gövde uzunluğuna bağlıdır. Detaylı boyut için kürek rehberimize bakınız.
tr::What size engine do I need for a RIB: Bir motor için hangi boyutta motora RIBihtiyacım var?
tr::Engine size depends on boat length a: Motor boyutu tekne uzunluğu ve ağırlığına bağlıdır. 3m RIB genellikle 15–25 HPmetre, 4,5m RIB 40–60 HPve 6m RIB 90–150 mesafe tutarHP. Her zaman HP teknenizin maksimum derecelendirme plakasını takip edin.
tr::PVC is lighter, more affordable, and: PVC daha hafif, daha uygun fiyatlı ve tamiri daha kolaydır — eğlence amaçlı kullanım için idealdir.Hypalon () daha uzunCSMUV ömürlü üstün ve kimyasal direnç sunar, ticari ve askeri uygulamalar için tercih edilir.Aquafarer ürün katmanına göre her ikisini de kullanır.
tr::What SUP width is best for stability: SUP Stabilite için en iyi genişlik hangisi?
tr::For beginners, a width of 33–34 inch: Yeni başlayanlar için 33–34 inç genişlik, stabilite ve kürek çekme kolaylığı arasında en iyi dengeyi sağlar. 32 inçten daha dar olan tahtalar, yeni kürekçiler için ucuz hissettirir. Aquafarer SUP Explorer 11 33 inç boyunda öğrenmek için idealdir.
tr::How do I choose SUP volume for my we: SUP Kiloma göre hacim nasıl seçebilirim?
tr::Multiply your weight in kg by 2.2 fo: Başlangıç seviyesine uygun bir hacim hedefi için ağırlığınızı kg cinsinden 2.2 ile çarpın. Örneğin, 75 kg ağırlığında bir kürekçi en az 165 litre ihtiyaç duyar, ancak 220–260 litre öğrenme için çok daha stabildir. SUP Explorer 11, 100 kg'ya kadar sürücüler için uygun olan 260 litre sunar.
tr::What size engine do I need for my in: Şişme teknem için hangi boyutta motora ihtiyacım var?
AirDeck 270 için 6'ya kadar HPkullanın. AirDeck 360 için 15'e HPkadar. RIB 330 için 40'a HPkadar. RIB 450 Patrol için ise HP60'a kadar. Her zaman HP tekneninizdeki maksimum derecelendirme plakasını kontrol edin ve asla aşmayın.
tr::What floor type is best for an infla: Şişme tekne için en iyi zemin tipi nedir?
tr::Aluminum slat floors provide the bes: Alüminyum çıta zeminler en iyi performansı sağlar — sert, planyalanma kapasitesine uygun ve ayakta durmak için stabildir. Hava güverteleri daha hafif, daha küçük paketlenir ama daha esnek olur. Yuvarlanabilir zeminler en basit ve en uygun maliyetli olanıdır ancak en az sertlik sunar. Ana kullanımınıza göre seçin: balık tutma ve hız slat zeminleri tercih eder; taşınabilirlik hava güvertelerini tercih eder.
tr::Aquafarer offers the best value in i: Aquafarer şişirilebilir su sporları ekipmanlarında en iyi değeri sunar. Red Paddle Co ile karşılaştırıldığında, Aquafarer performansın %90'ını maliyetin %60'ıyla sağlar. iRocker ile karşılaştırıldığında, Aquafarer daha yüksek kalite üç katmanlı askeri PVC sınıf ve daha PSI yüksek dereceler kullanır. Bluefin ile karşılaştırıldığında, Aquafarer üstün malzeme özellikleri sunar. Çoğu eğlence amaçlı kürekçi için Aquafarer kalite ve fiyat arasında en iyi dengeyi sunar.
tr::Yes. SUP fishing is increasingly pop: Evet.SUP Balıkçılık giderek daha popüler hale geliyor çünkü ayakta durma pozisyonu suya mükemmel görüş sağlıyor. Denge için en az 11 feet uzunluğunda ve 33–34 inç genişliğinde bir tahta seçin. Güverte bungeelerine sabit kamış bir sat tutucu, küçük bir çapa ekleyin ve her zaman PFDbir tayı takın. Aquafarer SUP Explorer 11, gündelik balıkçılık için iyi çalışır.
tr::Can I do yoga on a SUP board?: Tahta üzerinde yoga yapabilir SUP miyim?
tr::Absolutely. SUP yoga combines tradit: Kesinlikle.SUP Yoga, geleneksel pozları yüzen bir platformun zorluğuyla birleştirerek daha derin stabilizator kaslarını harekete geçiriyor. 33 inç veya daha geniş bir tahta ile yumuşak, tutucu bir güverte pedi kullanın. Sakin, sığ suda çapa ile pratik yapın. Aşağıya doğru köpek, savaşçı II ve ağaç pozu gibi temel pozlarla başlayın. SUP Explorer 11, tam EVA güverte pediyle çok uygundur.
tr::What are the airline rules for trave: Şişme bir uçak ile seyahat için havayolu kuralları nelerdirSUP?
tr::Most airlines accept SUP backpacks a: Çoğu havayolu sırt SUP çantalarını 23–32 kg'dan küçükse teslim edilen bagaj olarak kabul eder. Aquafarer Sırt çantası yaklaşık 90x40x30 cm boyutunda ve paketlendiğinde yaklaşık 15 kg ağırlığındadır. Bazı havayolları aşırı boy bagaj ücreti talep edebilir. Erken varın, el bagajınıza kanatları sarın ve pompayı ayrı olarak kullanın ve çantayı kırılgan olarak etiketleyin. Uçmadan önce her zaman havayolunun spor ekipman politikasını araştırın.
tr::What safety equipment do I need for: Soğuk su kürek çekmek için hangi güvenlik ekipmanına ihtiyacım var?
tr::Water below 15°C requires thermal pr: 15°C'nin altındaki sularda termal koruma gereklidir. 8–14°C için bot, eldiven ve kapüşonlu bir dlak kıyafet veya kuru giysi kullanın. 14–20°C için ise 3/2mm dalış giysi yeterlidir. Termal koruma ve güvenlik için her zaman uygun şekilde oturan bir giyin PFD . Zorunlu ekipman gereksinimleri için yerel düzenlemeleri kontrol edin.
tr::Minimum order quantities (MOQs) vary: Minimum sipariş miktarları (MOQs) ürün türü ve karmaşıklığa göre değişir. Mevcut modellerde özel markalama genellikle 5–10 ünite gerektirir. Tamamen özel gövde tasarımları daha yüksek MOQsbir üretim gerektirir. Detaylı fiyat teklifi için ihtiyaçlarınızı satış ekibimizle iletişime geçirin. Özel renkler ve logolardan tamamen özgün kalıp tasarımlarına kadar her şeyi biz hallederiz.
tr::Can I put my own logo on Aquafarer p: Ürünlere kendi logomu koyabilir Aquafarer miyim?
tr::Yes. Our OEM service includes custom: Evet. OEM Hizmetimiz, özel logo yerleştirme, özel renk şemaları ve özel paketleme içermektedir. Ürün türüne bağlı olarak pad baskı, ısı transferi ve nakış seçenekleri sunuyoruz. Sanat eserlerinizi ve özelliklerinizi satış ekibimize göndererek teklif ve teslim süresi tahmini alın.
tr::Inflate to the board's rated maximum: En iyi performans için kartın en iyi maksimumuna PSI şişirin — genellikle kaliteli şişme için 15–18 PSI SUPsderece. Aquafarer SUP Explorer 11 en iyi performans gösterir ve 15–18 PSIderecede performans gösterir. Düşük şişirme, kartın yumuşak hissettirmesine ve kötü izlenmesine neden olur. Aşırı şişirme limitli maksimumun üzerine çıkmak, drop-stitch dişlere zarar verme riski taşır. Valfin yanındaki etikette kartınızın özel derecesini kontrol edin.
tr::How do I clean and maintain the EVA: Deck pedini nasıl temizleyip bakımını EVA yapacağım?
tr::Rinse the deck pad with fresh water: Her seanstan sonra deck pedini taze suyla durulayın. Kir veya lekeler için hafif sabun ve yumuşak fırça kullanın — sert kimyasallardan kaçının. Kenarlar kalkmaya başlarsa, az miktarda su geçirmez deniz yapıştırıcısı uygulayın ve 24 saat boyunca ağırlık altında basın. UV Kullanılmadığında tahtayı doğrudan kullanmadan uzak tutun ki pedlerin bozulmasını önleyin.
tr::Yes. RIBs with rigid fiberglass or a: Evet. RIBs sert fiberglass veya alüminyum gövdeli tekniler taşımak için küçük bir tekne römorku gerektirir. Şişme tüpler kompakt depolama için söndürülebilir, ancak sert gövde bir römork gerektirir. AirDeck serisi (tamamen şişme) römork gerektirmez ve bir araba bagajında taşınabilir.
tr::Can I use a SUP board as a kayak?: Bir SUP boardunu kano olarak kullanabilir miyim?
tr::Yes. Many SUP boards, including the: Evet. Aquafarer Explorer 11 de dahil olmak üzere birçok SUP tahtasında, bir kano koltuğunun takılmasına izin veren D halkaları bulunur. Bir SUP ile kano koltuğu ve tek bıçaklı kürek kullanmak, daha uzun geziler veya balık tutma için rahat bir oturma pozisyonu sağlar. Bazı markalar, koltuklar ve daha uzun küreklerle birlikte özel kano dönüştürme kitleri sunar.
tr::Do I need to rinse my inflatable boa: Okyanus kullanımından sonra şişme tahtamı durulamam gerekiyor mu?
tr::Yes — always rinse your board, fins,: Evet — tuzlu su kullandıktan sonra her zaman tahtanızı, yüzgeçlerinizi, pompanızı ve küreğinizi tatlı suyla durulayın. Tuz kristalleri dikişlerin ve valflerin içine işleyerek mikrosızıntılara ve korozyona neden olur. Tahtayı söndürmeden ve depolamadan önce gölgede kurutun. Düzenli durulama, şişme su aracınızın ömrünü büyük ölçüde uzatır.
tr::Do I really need a leash for SUP?: SUP için gerçekten tasma takmam gerekiyor mu?
tr::Yes — always wear a leash. A coiled: Evet — her zaman tasma takın. Sarmal bir SUP tasma, bileğinize veya baldırınıza bağlanır ve düşerseniz tahtanın sizinle kalmasını sağlar. Açık suda, tasma sizi yüzdürme cihazınızdan ayrılmaktan koruyarak hayatınızı kurtarabilir. Nehirde kürek çekerken, sıkışmayı önlemek için hızlı salınımlı bir tasma kullanın.
tr::Is Aquafarer a trading company or a: Aquafarer bir ticaret şirketi mi yoksa üretici mi?
tr::Neither a pure factory nor a trading: Ne saf bir fabrika ne de bir ticaret şirketi — Aquafarer LLC, kendi üretim altyapısına sahip bir marka şirketidir. Aquafarer LLC (New Mexico, ABD) küresel dağıtımı, sözleşmeleri, faturalamayı ve satış sonrası hizmetleri yönetirken, Aquafarer Qingdao Üretim Merkezi 12.000 m²’lik kendi tesisimizde Ar-Ge, üretim ve kalite kontrolü yürütmektedir. Aracı yok: her sipariş doğrudan fabrikadan gönderilir.
tr::Why is my contract with a US company: Mallar Qingdao'dan sevk edilirken neden ABD şirketiyle sözleşmem var?
tr::Aquafarer LLC (New Mexico, USA) is t: Aquafarer LLC (New Mexico, ABD), sözleşme imzalayan, fatura düzenleyen ve satış sonrası destek sağlayan küresel ticari varlıkken, Qingdao Üretim Merkezi her siparişi FOB Qingdao'da üretip gönderir. Bu çift merkezli yapı, ABD standartlarında sözleşme ve hesaplaşmayı korurken, fabrika fiyatlarını ve tam üretim şeffaflığını sürdürür.
da::Frequently asked questions about inf: Ofte stillede spørgsmål om oppustelige SUP brædder, kajakker, joller, RIBs sikkerhedsudstyr og vandsport.
da::Is SUP hard to learn?: Er SUP det svært at lære?
da::Not at all. Most beginners stand up: Slet ikke. De fleste begyndere rejser sig op og padler allerede i deres første session. Vores All-Around-serie SUP har ekstra brede, stabile platforme designet specielt til førstegangspadlere. Start på roligt vand, og du vil sejle på få minutter.
da::Can I use it in the ocean?: Kan jeg bruge den i havet?
da::Yes. Aquafarer SUP boards are built: Ja. Aquafarer SUP Brætterne er bygget til brug i havet, søer og floder. Vores Touring-serie håndterer kystslynge, og alle brætter bruger marinekvalitet PVC , der modstår saltvandskorrosion. Skyl med ferskvand efter brug i havet.
da::How long does it take to inflate?: Hvor lang tid tager det at puste op?
da::With the included dual-action pump,: Med den medfølgende dobbeltvirkende pumpe blæser de fleste boards op til 12–15 PSI på under 5 minutter. Vores elektriske pumpemulighed reducerer det til under 2 minutter. Deflation og pakning tager cirka 3 minutter.
da::Can I travel with an inflatable SUP?: Kan jeg rejse med en oppustelig bil SUP?
da::Absolutely. Every Aquafarer board pa: Helt sikkert. Hvert Aquafarer board kan pakkes i en rygsækstørrelse bæretaske, der er designet til nem rejse – tjek dine bæretøjsstørrelser og vægtregler. Med kun 18-22 lbs er det nemt at bære til stranden, søen eller gennem lufthavnsterminaler.
da::Our All-Around SUPs support up to 22: Vores All-Around SUPs understøtter op til 220 lbs. Touring- og Yoga-serierne understøtter op til 250 lbs. RIB Både understøtter typisk 600–1500 lbs afhængigt af model. Til tandembrug eller tungere læs tilbyder vores oppustelige både muligheder med højere kapacitet.
da::What comes in the box?: Hvad følger der med i kassen?
da::Every Aquafarer SUP includes the boa: Alle Aquafarer SUP inkluderer board, rejserygsæk, dobbeltvirkende håndpumpe, aftagelig finne, spiralline og reparationssæt. Nogle modeller inkluderer også en opgradering af carbonpaddle. Oppustelige både inkluderer båd, pumpe, reparationssæt og årer.
da::Yes. We offer curated bundles that s: Ja. Vi tilbyder kuraterede pakker, der sparer dig penge sammenlignet med at købe varer separat. Kontakt vores salgsteam for aktuelle pakkekampagner og volumenrabatter.
da::Do I need a life vest on a SUP?: Skal jeg bruge en redningsvest på en SUP?
da::Yes. Many jurisdictions legally requ: Ja. Mange jurisdiktioner kræver lovmæssigt en redningsvest på ethvert vandfartøj, herunder SUPs. Selv hvor det ikke er påkrævet, CE er en certificeret redningsvest essentielt sikkerhedsudstyr. Vi anbefaler at bære den hele tiden på vandet.
da::Do I need to register my inflatable: Skal jeg registrere min oppustelige båd?
da::Requirements vary by jurisdiction. I: Kravene varierer fra jurisdiktion til jurisdiktion. I de fleste regioner kræver oppustelige både med motorer over en vis hestekræfter registrering. Umotoriserede SUPs og små joller gør typisk ikke. Tjek din lokale søfartsmyndighed for specifikke regler.
da::Clean the area, cut a patch with rou: Rengør området, klip et stykke med afrundede hjørner, påfør PVC lim, pres fast, og vent 24 timer før du puster op.Aquafarer Brædderne inkluderer et reparationssæt. For detaljerede instruktioner, se vores guide til reparation af oppustelige genstande.
da::How should I store my inflatable SUP: Hvordan skal jeg opbevare min oppustelige vogn SUP?
da::Rinse with fresh water, dry complete: Skyl med frisk vand, tør helt, tøm helt luften, rul løst fra næsen, og opbevar den i bæretasken et køligt og tørt sted væk fra direkte sollys. Opbevar aldrig våd eller i ekstreme temperaturer.
da::Inflatable boards offer portability,: Oppustelige boards tilbyder bærbarhed, opbevaringsbekvemmelighed og stødabsorbering. Hårde boards giver maksimal stivhed og hastighed. For de fleste rekreative brugere er en kvalitets oppustelig brædder med drop-stitch kerne det praktiske valg.
da::What wind speed is too high for SUP?: Hvilken vindhastighed er for høj til SUP?
da::Beginners: over 10 mph (8 knots). In: Begyndere: over 10 mph (8 knob). Mellem: over 15 mph (13 knob). Avanceret: over 20 mph (17 knob). Hvis du er i tvivl, må du ikke gå ud. Havvind (blæsende fra land til hav) er farligt på ethvert færdighedsniveau.
da::All Aquafarer products are backed by: Alle Aquafarer produkter er dækket af en omfattende producentgaranti. Oppustelig bådtubstof, sømme og skrog er dækket af en 5-årig begrænset garanti;SUP boards og tilbehør har 2-årig begrænset garanti. Garantien dækker fejl i materialer og håndværk under normal brug.
da::File a claim by contacting our suppo: Indgiv en klage ved at kontakte vores supportteam med dit ordrenummer, billeder af problemet og en kort beskrivelse. De fleste krav bliver gennemgået inden for 2 hverdage. Godkendte krav modtager en udskiftnings- eller reparationsinstruktion inden for få dage.
da::In-stock orders ship within 2–3 busi: Ordrer på lager sendes inden for 2–3 hverdage. Amerikanske indenlandske ordrer ankommer inden for 5–10 hverdage. Internationale ordrer ankommer inden for 10–20 hverdage afhængigt af destination. Hastende ordrer kan fremskyndes.
da::We accept returns within 30 days of: Vi accepterer returer inden for 30 dage efter levering af ubrugte produkter i original emballage. Specialbestillinger OEM kan ikke returneres. Kontakt vores supportteam for at starte en retur — vi giver en forudbetalt forsendelseslabel.
da::Yes. We offer private label and cust: Ja. Vi tilbyder private label- og specialdesigntjenester til virksomheder. Fra specialdesignet branding på eksisterende modeller til fuldt tilpassede skrogdesigns kan vores ingeniørteam udvikle produkter under dit brand. Minimumsordremængder gælder.
da::For SUP: the paddle should be 6–8 in: For SUP: padlen skal være 15–20 cm højere end din højde. For kajak: pagajlængden afhænger af bådens bredde og torsolængde. Se vores pagajguide for detaljeret størrelse.
da::What size engine do I need for a RIB: Hvilken størrelse motor skal jeg bruge til en RIB?
da::Engine size depends on boat length a: Motorstørrelsen afhænger af bådens længde og vægt. En 3m RIB kan typisk håndtere 15–25, HP en 4,5m RIB kan håndtere 40–60 HP, og en 6m RIB kan håndtere 90–150 HP. Følg altid den maksimale HP mærkningsplade på din båd.
da::What is the difference between PVC a: Hvad er forskellen mellem PVC og Hypalon?
da::PVC is lighter, more affordable, and: PVC er lettere, mere overkommelig og lettere at reparere — ideel til rekreativ brug.Hypalon (CSM) tilbyder overlegen UV og kemisk resistens med længere levetid, foretrukken til kommercielle og militære formål.Aquafarer Bruger begge afhængigt af produktniveauet.
da::What SUP width is best for stability: Hvilken SUP bredde er bedst for stabilitet?
da::For beginners, a width of 33–34 inch: For begyndere giver en bredde på 33–34 tommer den bedste balance mellem stabilitet og rolethed. Brætter, der er smallere end 32 tommer, føles tynde for nye padlere. Aquafarer SUP Explorer 11 med 33 tommer er ideel til læring.
da::How do I choose SUP volume for my we: Hvordan vælger jeg SUP volumen til min vægt?
da::Multiply your weight in kg by 2.2 fo: Gang din vægt i kg med 2,2 for et volumenmål, der er begyndervenligt. For eksempel skal en padler på 75 kg have mindst 165 liter, men 220–260 liter er meget mere stabilt til læring. SUP Explorer 11 tilbyder 260 liter, egnet til ryttere op til 100 kg.
da::What size engine do I need for my in: Hvilken motorstørrelse skal jeg bruge til min oppustelige båd?
For AirDeck 270, brug op til 6 HP. For AirDeck 360, op til 15 HP. For RIB 330, op til 40 HP. For RIB 450 Patrol, op til 60 HP. Tjek altid HP max-mærkningsskiltet på din båd og overskrid det aldrig.
da::What floor type is best for an infla: Hvilken gulvtype er bedst til en oppustelig båd?
da::Aluminum slat floors provide the bes: Aluminiumslam-gulve giver den bedste ydeevne — stive, planegnede og stabile til stående. Luftdæk er lettere og pakker mindre, men fleksibeler mere. Rullegulve er de simpleste og mest overkommelige, men tilbyder mindst stivhed. Vælg ud fra dit primære brugsområde: fiskeri og fart foretrækker lamellere; bærbarhed favoriserer luftdæk.
da::How does Aquafarer compare to other: Hvordan Aquafarer sammenlignes det med andre mærker?
da::Aquafarer offers the best value in i: Aquafarer tilbyder den bedste værdi for oppusteligt vandsportsudstyr. Sammenlignet med Red Aquafarer Paddle Co leverer 90% af ydelsen til 60% af prisen. Sammenlignet med iRocker Aquafarer bruger den højere kvalitet triple-layer militærkvalitet PVC og højere PSI ratings. Sammenlignet med Bluefin Aquafarer tilbyder den overlegne materialspecifikationer. For de fleste fritidspadlere Aquafarer giver den den bedste balance mellem kvalitet og pris.
da::Can I fish from a SUP board?: Kan jeg fiske fra et SUP bræt?
da::Yes. SUP fishing is increasingly pop: Ja. SUP Fiskeri bliver mere og mere populært, fordi stående position giver fremragende udsyn til vandet. Vælg et board, der er mindst 11 fod langt og 33–34 tommer bredt for stabilitet. Tilføj en mælkekasse med stangholdere fastgjort til dækkets bungees, et lille anker, og bær altid en PFD. Aquafarer SUP Explorer 11 fungerer godt til afslappet fiskeri.
da::Can I do yoga on a SUP board?: Kan jeg lave yoga på en SUP bræt?
da::Absolutely. SUP yoga combines tradit: Absolut.SUP Yoga kombinerer traditionelle stillinger med udfordringen ved en flydende platform, hvor dybere stabilisatormuskler aktiveres. Brug et board på 33 tommer eller bredere med en blød, gribende dækplade. Øv dig i roligt, lavt vand med et anker. Start med foundation-stillinger som downward dog, warrior II og træstilling. SUP Explorer 11 med sin fulde EVA deck pad er velegnet til det.

Sommige modellen bevatten ook een upgrade van een carbon peddel. Opblaasbare boten zijn onder andere de boot, pomp, reparatiekit en riemen.

nl::Do I need a life vest on a SUP?: Heb ik een reddingsvest nodig op een SUP?

nl::What wind speed is too high for SUP?: Voor welke windsnelheid is te hoog SUP?
nl::Beginners: over 10 mph (8 knots). In: Beginners: meer dan 10 mph (8 knopen). Middelmatig: meer dan 15 mph (13 knopen). Gevorderd: meer dan 20 mph (17 knopen). Bij twijfel, ga dan niet naar buiten. Wind van land naar zee (van land naar zee) is gevaarlijk op elk vaardigheidsniveau.
nl::All Aquafarer products are backed by: Alle Aquafarer producten worden gedekt door een uitgebreide fabrikantgarantie. nl::Yes. We offer private label and cust: Ja. Wij bieden private label en maatwerk ontwerpdiensten voor bedrijven. Van maatwerk branding op bestaande modellen tot volledig aangepaste rompontwerpen, ons engineeringteam kan producten onder jouw merk ontwikkelen. Minimale bestelhoeveelheden gelden.

nl::What size engine do I need for a RIB: Welke maat motor heb ik nodig voor een RIB?

nl::What is the difference between PVC a: Wat is het verschil tussen PVC en Hypalon?
nl::PVC is lighter, more affordable, and: PVC is lichter, betaalbaarder en gemakkelijker te repareren — ideaal voor recreatief gebruik.Hypalon (CSM) biedt superieure UV en chemische bestendigheid met een langere levensduur, en wordt gewenst voor commerciële en militaire toepassingen.Aquafarer Beide worden gebruikt afhankelijk van het productniveau.
nl::What SUP width is best for stability: Welke SUP breedte is het beste voor stabiliteit?
nl::For beginners, a width of 33–34 inch: Voor beginners biedt een breedte van 80–70 cm de beste balans tussen stabiliteit en peddelgemak. Planken die smaller zijn dan 70 cm voelen voor beginnende peddelaars kantelend aan. De Aquafarer SUP Explorer 11 op 33 inch is ideaal om te leren.
nl::How do I choose SUP volume for my we: Hoe kies ik SUP volume voor mijn gewicht?

Bijvoorbeeld, een peddelaar van 75 kg heeft minstens 165 liter nodig, maar 220–260 liter is veel stabieler om te leren. De SUP Explorer 11 biedt 260 liter, geschikt voor rijders tot 100 kg.
nl::What size engine do I need for my in: Welke motormaat heb ik nodig voor mijn opblaasboot?
Voor de AirDeck 270, gebruik tot 6 HP. Voor de AirDeck 360 tot 15 HP. Voor de RIB 330 tot 40 HP. Voor de RIB 450 Patrouille, tot 60 HP. Controleer altijd de maximale HP classificatieplaat van je boot en overschrijd die nooit.
nl::What floor type is best for an infla: Welk vloertype is het beste voor een opblaasbare boot?
nl::Aluminum slat floors provide the bes: Aluminium latvloeren leveren de beste prestaties — stijf, geschikt voor schaven en stabiel om te staan. Luchtdekken zijn lichter en kleiner gepakt, maar flexibeler maken. Oprolvloeren zijn het eenvoudigst en meest betaalbaar, maar bieden de minste stijfheid. Kies op basis van je belangrijkste gebruik: vissen en snelheid geven de voorkeur aan latvloeren; draagbaarheid is gunstiger voor luchtdekken.
nl::How does Aquafarer compare to other: Hoe Aquafarer verhoudt het zich tot andere merken?

nl::Can I fish from a SUP board?: Kan ik vissen vanaf een SUP plank?
nl::Yes. SUP fishing is increasingly pop: Ja.SUP Vissen wordt steeds populairder omdat de staande houding uitstekend zicht op het water biedt. Kies een plank van minstens 31 voet lang en 33–34 inch breed voor stabiliteit. Voeg een melkkrat toe met hengelhouders die aan de bungees van het dek zijn bevestigd, een klein anker, en draag altijd een PFD. De Aquafarer SUP Explorer 11 werkt goed voor casual vissen.
nl::Can I do yoga on a SUP board?: Kan ik yoga doen op een SUP plank?
nl::Absolutely. SUP yoga combines tradit: Absoluut.SUP Yoga combineert traditionele houdingen met de uitdaging van een drijvend platform, waarbij diepere stabilisatorspieren worden geactiveerd. Gebruik een board van 70 cm of breder met een zacht, gripvol deckpad. Oefen in kalm, ondiep water met een anker. Begin met foundation poses zoals downward dog, warrior II en boomhouding. De SUP Explorer 11 met zijn volledige EVA deck pad is goed geschikt.
nl::What are the airline rules for trave: Wat zijn de regels van de luchtvaartmaatschappij voor reizen met een opblaasbare boot SUP?
nl::Most airlines accept SUP backpacks a: De meeste SUP luchtvaartmaatschappijen accepteren rugzakken als ingecheckte bagage als ze onder de 23–32 kg vallen. Kom vroeg aan, wikkel vinnen en pomp apart in je handbagage en label de tas als breekbaar. Onderzoek altijd het sportuitrustingsbeleid van je luchtvaartmaatschappij voordat je vliegt.
nl::What safety equipment do I need for: Welke veiligheidsuitrusting heb ik nodig voor het peddelen in koud water?
nl::Water below 15°C requires thermal pr: Water onder 15°C vereist thermische bescherming. Voor 8–14°C gebruik een wetsuit of droogpak met laarzen, handschoenen en capuchon. Voor 14–20°C is een wetsuit van 3/2 mm voldoende. Draag altijd een goed passende wet PFD voor thermische bescherming en veiligheid. Controleer de lokale regelgeving voor verplichte uitrustingsvereisten.
nl::What are the minimum order quantitie: Wat zijn de minimale bestelhoeveelheden voor OEM/ODM?

Wij behandelen alles van aangepaste kleuren en logo's tot volledig originele malontwerpen.
nl::Can I put my own logo on Aquafarer p: Kan ik mijn eigen logo op Aquafarer producten zetten?

Stuur uw artwork en specificaties naar ons verkoopteam voor een offerte en een schatting van de doorlooptijd.
nl::What PSI should I inflate my SUP to?: Waar PSI moet ik mijn SUP naartoe opblaasen?
nl::Inflate to the board's rated maximum: Blaas op tot het maximale aantal van het board PSI voor de beste prestaties — meestal 15–18 PSI voor kwalitatief opblaasbare elementen SUPs. De Aquafarer SUP Explorer 11 presteert het beste bij 15–18 PSI. Onderinflatie zorgt ervoor dat het board zacht aanvoelt en slecht volgt. Overmatige inflatie boven het maximale aantal kan de drop-stitch schroefdraad beschadigen. Controleer de sticker bij het ventiel voor de specifieke waarde van je board.
nl::How do I clean and maintain the EVA: Hoe maak en onderhoud ik het EVA dekpad?
nl::Rinse the deck pad with fresh water: Spoel het terrasblad na elke sessie af met vers water. Voor vuil of vlekken gebruik je milde zeep en een zachte borstel — vermijd agressieve chemicaliën. Als de randen beginnen los te gaan, breng dan een kleine hoeveelheid waterdichte maritieme lijm aan en pers 24 uur onder gewicht. Houd de plank uit direct UV gebruik wanneer deze niet in gebruik is om degradatie van de pad te voorkomen.
nl::Do I need a trailer for a RIB?: Heb ik een aanhanger nodig voor een RIB?
nl::Yes. RIBs with rigid fiberglass or a: Ja. RIBs met een stijve fiberglass- of aluminiumromp hebben een kleine boottrailer nodig voor transport. De AirDeck-serie (volledig opblaasbaar) heeft geen trailer nodig en kan in de kofferbak van een auto worden vervoerd.
nl::Can I use a SUP board as a kayak?: Kan ik een SUP board als kajak gebruiken?
nl::Yes. Many SUP boards, including the: Ja. Veel SUP-borden, inclusief de Aquafarer Explorer 11, hebben D-ringen waarmee een kajakstoel kan worden bevestigd. Sommige merken bieden speciale kajakomzettingskits met stoelen en langere peddels.
nl::Do I need to rinse my inflatable boa: Moet ik mijn opblaasbare board afspoelen na gebruik in de oceaan?
nl::Yes — always rinse your board, fins,: Ja — spoel altijd je board, vinnen, pomp en peddel af met zoet water na gebruik in zout water. Zoutkristallen dringen in naden en ventielen, waardoor micro-lekken en corrosie ontstaan. Droog het board in de schaduw voordat je het leeg laat lopen en opbergt. Regelmatig spoelen verlengt de levensduur van je opblaasbare vaartuig aanzienlijk.
nl::Do I really need a leash for SUP?: Heb ik echt een riem nodig voor SUP?
nl::Yes — always wear a leash. A coiled: Ja — draag altijd een leash. Een opgerolde SUP leash bevestigt je aan je enkel of kuit en houdt het board bij je als je valt. In open water kan een leash je leven redden door te voorkomen dat je gescheiden raakt van je drijfmiddel. Voor rivierpeddelen, gebruik een quick-release leash om verstrikking te voorkomen.
nl::Is Aquafarer a trading company or a: Is Aquafarer een handelsonderneming of een fabrikant?

Geen tussenpersonen: elke bestelling wordt direct vanuit de fabriek verzonden.
nl::Why is my contract with a US company: Waarom is mijn contract met een Amerikaans bedrijf als de goederen vanuit Qingdao worden verzonden?

pt::What SUP width is best for stability: Qual SUP largura é melhor para estabilidade?
pt::For beginners, a width of 33–34 inch: Para iniciantes, uma largura de 33–34 polegadas oferece o melhor equilíbrio entre estabilidade e facilidade de remada. pt::How do I choose SUP volume for my we: Como escolho SUP o volume para o meu peso?

pt::What floor type is best for an infla: Qual tipo de piso é o melhor para um barco inflável?

pt::How does Aquafarer compare to other: Como Aquafarer se compara a outras marcas?
pt::Aquafarer offers the best value in i: Aquafarer oferece o melhor valor em equipamentos infláveis para esportes aquáticos. Comparado à Red Paddle Co, Aquafarer entrega 90% do desempenho a 60% do custo. Comparado ao iRocker, utiliza equipamento Aquafarer militar de três camadas de qualidade PVC superior e PSI classificações mais altas. Comparado ao Bluefin, Aquafarer oferece especificações de material superiores. Para a maioria dos remadores recreativos, Aquafarer oferece o melhor equilíbrio entre qualidade e preço.
pt::Can I fish from a SUP board?: Posso pescar de uma SUP tábua?
pt::Yes. SUP fishing is increasingly pop: Sim.SUP A pesca está cada vez mais popular porque a posição em pé oferece excelente visibilidade para a água. Escolha uma prancha com pelo menos 11 pés de comprimento e 33–34 polegadas de largura para estabilidade. Adicione uma caixa de leite com suportes para varas fixadas aos bungees do convés, uma pequena âncora e sempre use PFD um . Aquafarer SUP O Explorer 11 funciona bem para pesca casual.
pt::Can I do yoga on a SUP board?: Posso fazer yoga em uma SUP prancha?
pt::Absolutely. SUP yoga combines tradit: Com certeza.SUP O yoga combina posturas tradicionais com o desafio de uma plataforma flutuante, envolvendo músculos estabilizadores mais profundos. Use uma prancha de 33 polegadas ou mais larga com uma base de deck macia e aderente. Pratique em águas calmas e rasas com uma âncora. Comece com posturas de base como cão para baixo, guerreiro II e postura da árvore. SUP A Explorer 11, com seu EVA almofada de deck completo, é muito adequada.
pt::What are the airline rules for trave: Quais são as regras das companhias aéreas para viajar com um inflável SUP?
pt::Most airlines accept SUP backpacks a: A maioria das companhias aéreas aceita SUP mochilas como bagagem despachada se tiver menos de 23–32 kg. A Aquafarer mochila mede aproximadamente 90x40x30 cm e pesa cerca de 15 kg embalada. Algumas companhias podem cobrar taxas por bagagem de tamanho excessivo. Chegue cedo, enrole as aletas e bombee separadamente na bagagem de mão, e rotule a bolsa como frágil. Sempre pesquise a política de equipamentos esportivos da sua companhia aérea antes de voar.
pt::What safety equipment do I need for: Que equipamento de segurança eu preciso para remar em água fria?
pt::Water below 15°C requires thermal pr: Água abaixo de 15°C requer proteção térmica. Para 8–14°C, use uma roupa de neoprene ou drysuit com botas, luvas e capuz. Para 14–20°C, uma roupa de neoprene de 3/2 mm é suficiente. Sempre use uma roupa adequada PFD para proteção térmica e segurança. Verifique as normas locais para requisitos obrigatórios de equipamento.
pt::What are the minimum order quantitie: Quais são as quantidades mínimas de pedido OEM para /ODM?
pt::Minimum order quantities (MOQs) vary: Quantidades mínimas de pedido (MOQs) variam conforme o tipo de produto e a complexidade. A personalização personalizada em modelos existentes normalmente requer de 5 a 10 unidades. Projetos de casco totalmente personalizados exigem um valor mais MOQs alto. Entre em contato com nossa equipe de vendas com seus requisitos para obter um orçamento detalhado. Cuidamos de tudo, desde cores e logotipos personalizados até designs de moldes totalmente originais.
pt::Can I put my own logo on Aquafarer p: Posso colocar meu próprio logo nos Aquafarer produtos?
pt::Yes. Our OEM service includes custom: Sim. Nosso OEM serviço inclui colocação personalizada de logotipos, esquemas de cores personalizados e embalagens personalizadas. Oferecemos opções de impressão em pad, transferência de calor e bordado, dependendo do tipo de produto. Envie sua obra e especificações para nossa equipe de vendas para um orçamento e estimativa de prazo.
pt::What PSI should I inflate my SUP to?: Até onde PSI devo inflar SUP ?
pt::Inflate to the board's rated maximum: Infle até o máximo avaliado pela placa PSI para melhor desempenho — normalmente entre 15 e 18 PSI para infláveis de qualidade SUPs. Aquafarer SUP A Explorer 11 tem melhor desempenho entre 15 e 18 PSI. A subinflação faz com que a placa fique macia e tenha mal de acompanhamento. Inflação excessiva além do máximo nominal pode danificar a drop-stitch rosca. Verifique o adesivo próximo à válvula para a classificação específica da sua placa.
pt::How do I clean and maintain the EVA: Como faço para limpar e manter a EVA base do deck?
pt::Rinse the deck pad with fresh water: Enxágue a base de deck com água fresca após cada sessão. Para sujeira ou manchas, use sabonete suave e uma escova macia — evite produtos químicos agressivos. Se as bordas começarem a levantar, aplique uma pequena quantidade de adesivo marinho impermeável e pressione sob peso por 24 horas. Mantenha a prancha fora do lado UV direto quando não estiver em uso para evitar a degradação da almofada.
pt::Do I need a trailer for a RIB?: Preciso de um trailer para RIB um ?
pt::Yes. RIBs with rigid fiberglass or a: Sim. RIBs com cascos rígidos de fibra de vidro ou alumínio exigem um pequeno reboque para transporte. Os tubos infláveis podem ser desinflados para armazenamento compacto, mas o casco rígido precisa de um reboque. A série AirDeck (totalmente inflável) não requer um reboque e pode ser transportada no porta-malas do carro.
pt::Can I use a SUP board as a kayak?: Posso usar uma prancha SUP como caiaque?
pt::Yes. Many SUP boards, including the: Sim. Muitas pranchas SUP, incluindo a Aquafarer Explorer 11, possuem argolas em D que permitem a fixação de um assento de caiaque. Usar uma SUP com um assento de caiaque e um remo de lâmina única oferece uma posição sentada confortável para viagens mais longas ou pesca. Algumas marcas oferecem kits de conversão dedicados para caiaque com assentos e remos mais longos.
pt::Do I need to rinse my inflatable boa: Preciso enxaguar minha prancha inflável após uso no oceano?
pt::Yes — always rinse your board, fins,: Sim — sempre enxágue sua prancha, quilhas, bomba e remo com água doce após usar em água salgada. Os cristais de sal entram nas costuras e válvulas, causando microvazamentos e corrosão. Seque a prancha na sombra antes de desinflar e armazenar. O enxágue regular prolonga dramaticamente a vida útil de sua embarcação inflável.
pt::Do I really need a leash for SUP?: Eu realmente preciso de uma leash para SUP?
pt::Yes — always wear a leash. A coiled: Sim — sempre use uma leash. Uma leash SUP enrolada prende-se ao tornozelo ou à panturrilha e mantém a prancha com você caso você caia. Em águas abertas, uma leash pode salvar sua vida evitando a separação do dispositivo de flutuação. Para remar em rios, use uma leash com liberação rápida para evitar aprisionamento.
pt::Is Aquafarer a trading company or a: O Aquafarer é uma empresa de comércio ou um fabricante?
pt::Neither a pure factory nor a trading: Nem fábrica pura nem empresa de comércio — Aquafarer LLC é uma empresa de marca com sua própria base de fabricação. Aquafarer LLC (New Mexico, EUA) gerencia a distribuição global, contratos, faturamento e assistência pós-venda, enquanto o Centro de Fabricação Aquafarer em Qingdao executa P&D, produção e controle de qualidade em nossa própria instalação de 12.000 m². Sem intermediários: todos os pedidos são enviados direto da fábrica.
pt::Why is my contract with a US company: Por que meu contrato é com uma empresa dos EUA se os produtos são enviados de Qingdao?
pt::Aquafarer LLC (New Mexico, USA) is t: Aquafarer LLC (New Mexico, EUA) é a entidade comercial global que assina contratos, emite faturas e fornece suporte pós-venda, enquanto o Centro de Fabricação de Qingdao produz e despacha cada pedido FOB Qingdao. Esta estrutura de dois centros mantém contratos e liquidações no padrão dos EUA, preservando o preço direto de fábrica e total transparência de produção.
